title: A fixed +-2.0 authority clamp cannot flip any of 96 seeded fixed gates
body: Measured on the #813 collapse fixture: with gate score spreads all exceeding 4.0 (shipped-seed fixture measured 27.0), a constant MAX_GATE_BIAS=2.0-wide selection bias could not rotate the top-k pair at any alpha within the clamp — recovery was structurally impossible and the router option existed only as a label. The remedy: the loss-free clamp is the batch's own measured selection-score spread (the smallest authority guaranteed wide enough, still bounded, still reported). Recovery then recorded at forward #2148 with cumulative entropy rising 0.3333 -> 0.844 and continuing past it. A bounded authority that is COUNT-DERIVED rather than DERIVED-FROM-THE-GATE carries the same shape as bias_clamp_exhausted: report the wall, do not keep nudging.

title: Two concurrent lanes committing one repo must stage and verify per-commit ownership
body:
The Kilo #814 lane and this DeepSeek #813 lane shared the repo checkout. The sibling lane's mesh-refresh commit swept this lane's staged slice into its own commit, and a follow-up Unstaged changes after reset:
M	src/CORE/training_intake.py
M	tests/test_training_intake_records.py discarded a clean DeepSeek commit in flight while its later branch rewrite stripped the swept content again (twice). The fix this lane adopted: create a lane-private branch (deepseek-engram-813) so the sibling's resets cannot reach the work, stage ONLY named lane files per commit, and verify each commit's ownership immediately after landing (git show --stat). Verified and used for every remaining slice; zero further sweeps. Wider fix to prescribe: per-lane worktrees for concurrent Freebuff sessions so two agents never share an index.

title: Record the live gap beside the mechanism tests instead of letting a green battery claim coverage
body: F1 NAT marking passes all adapter tests while the live technique-link stream measured 500/500 rows of severity info at ok_rate 1.0 — meaning ZERO negative rows are rescueable today, so 'pool carries measured negatives' is mechanism-true and live-false until a degraded payload arrives. The battery pins both sides explicitly: the marking mechanism on synthetic rows, and a live-shape twin asserting n_negative=0/n_nat_declared=0 for an all-success pool, named in the test docstring as #798's measurement. A green mechanism test must never be read as live evidence; the gap stays named where the mechanism is pinned.
